**Repaired finding submitted — status remains compliant, no redline.**

The verifier confirmed the substantive conclusion; the repair was to make the record explicit about why the two failed deterministic sub-checks are non-probative.

**What changed in the finding:**
- Rationale now expressly states that the "general-solicitation carve-out present" and "duration ≤ 12 months" checks presuppose an existing non-solicit, and that with no such covenant there is nothing for a carve-out or duration cap to attach to.
- Added the regex sweep `(shall|will) not (solicit|hire|employ|engage|induce)` and the term "engage" to the documented search evidence — both returned nothing.
- Noted that no redline or counterparty comment is proposed and the rendered text is identical to the original, as is correct for a compliant finding.
- Recorded our fallback parameters for future negotiation leverage should Kubient introduce a non-solicit.

**Evidence base (unchanged):** the only employment-related provisions are p0066 (independent contractor / no agency), p0051–p0052 (mutual indemnities referencing parties "hired by, employed, retained or under" a party's control), and p0061 (need-to-know disclosure to employees and directors). None restricts The Associated Press from soliciting or hiring Kubient personnel, so the preferred position — no non-solicit binding the Customer — is met on the face of the document.
